newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed after recent rally.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar tightly mixed after recent rally.

text.p: White sugar futures held steady in afternoon trade on Wednesday as the March/May spread took centre stage while players continued to roll spot positions forward before next week's March expiry.
Nearby values remained tightly mixed throughout the day although a firmer New York performance aided London's recent bullish sentiment, traders said.

White premium sellers were waiting at levels of $71 and above to take advantage of the gains in London but activity was centred around the forthcoming expiry of the March contract next week, they said.
At 1655GMT March was up $1.00 at $304.50 after hitting an intraday high of $305.50. May was up 70 cents at $302.00 while further forwards were slightly weaker.
Crossed trades by trade and commission house players on the March/May spread boosted the overall turnover of 4,523 lots in another heavy session and also widened the spread, traders said.
Market volume during Wednesday's session reached an all-time record high of 7,989 lots, surpassing the previous record of 7,215 lots set in April 1995.
In physical news, traders said Iran was likely to have rejected bids in its recent tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of white sugar for April delivery.
Paris positions edged their way higher but only the two nearby months were traded.
March was up $2.00 at $305.00 and May unchanged at $301.00. Matif volume amounted to 806 lots.
